definitions: Move at a regular pace by lifting and setting down each foot in turn, never having both feet off the ground at once.
Lead or drive (an animal) on foot.
Go over (an area) on foot, typically for exercise or pleasure.
Be acquitted of a charge, especially unexpectedly.
examples: She likes to walk in the park.
He will walk his dog every morning.
They decided to walk the entire trail.
The suspect was able to walk free.
I often walk to clear my head.
